description: Tier 1 functional WAAPI test scenarios for the Immerse Audio Renderer. Each scenario sets one property on the Immerse Effect via ak.wwise.core.object.setProperty and asserts a matching log line appears in the listener's debug stream within the timeout. Scenarios run in declared order; later steps may depend on earlier ones (e.g. HeadphoneEq requires EHM on + ConvolutionType=personalized).

scenarios.name: UserID: re-assert current user pushes through
ConvolutionType: discovery (observe what value type + log signature)
scenarios.comment: First run: capture whatever the Immerse plug-in logs when ConvolutionType is touched. Use the captured output to (a) confirm the value type/encoding for personalized vs universal, (b) derive expectLog regex. Then replace this discovery scenario with two assertion scenarios (one for each mode).

scenarios.name: HeadphoneEq: discovery (requires EHM on + personalized profile)
scenarios.comment: Requires EHM on (set above) AND ConvolutionType=personalized. Until ConvolutionType is wired up correctly above, this scenario may produce no log output. First run: capture what the plug-in logs when HeadphoneEq changes; derive expectLog regex from there.
